title: CyberCam
summary: 8MP retro camera with GIFs, MP4, timelapse, stop-motion & Wi-Fi gallery
description:
CyberCam is an open-source camera application for the M5Stack Cardputer Zero, developed by Cybern0mads.

Transform your Cardputer Zero into a creative handheld camera featuring full-resolution 8MP photography, retro filters, animated GIFs, and MP4 video recording.

Features:

8MP Photography: Capture full-resolution JPEG images.

16 Retro & Cyberpunk Filters: Game Boy-inspired, VHS, C64, neon, pixel-art, and other creative looks.

GIF & Boomerang: Create animated clips directly on your device.

MP4 Video: Record videos using the Cardputer Zero camera.

Timelapse: Capture images automatically and export them to MP4.

Stop Motion: Create animations with onion-skin preview and GIF/MP4 export.

On-Device Gallery: Browse and view captured media.

Wi-Fi Gallery: Access and download your creations through a token-protected browser interface.

Keyboard Controls: Designed for the Cardputer Zero's compact display and keyboard.

New in v0.5.3: Improved timelapse export reliability, encoding progress, and Gallery access after recording.

CyberCam is an independent community project by Cybern0mads.

Source: https://github.com/cybern0mads/CyberCam
